_doc: Canonical SHARED banned-vocabulary core. Both voice gates — {site}/scripts/check-banned-words.mjs and {product}/scripts/check-verboten-phrases.mjs — MUST enforce exactly these. This file is the single source of truth (canon: docs/brand/voice-and-naming-architecture.md §3a) and is vendored byte-identically into both repos. Drift is caught by scripts/check-banned-core-sync.mjs, which parses each gate's tier1-core / tier1b-core sentinel blocks and compares names + normalized regex bodies against these lists. 'tier1' is universal marketing-speak (retired everywhere off the allowlist in both repos). 'tier1b' is the anti-overclaim cluster (retired outright in {product}; marketing-surface-scoped in {site}) — shared words, different scope, identical patterns. 'body' is the regex source WITHOUT flags (gates may use /gi or /i as their scan needs require). To change the shared core: edit this file in one repo, copy it to the other, update both gate blocks, and let the sync gate confirm.
